description: Replace an access policy's complete subjects and targets, changing access permissions. Requires the current version from get_access_policy; a stale version returns HTTP 409 without retrying. Omitted name, description, effect, and enabled retain their stored values. Returns Portkey's acknowledgement; reread before retrying a conflict.

effect.description: Allow or deny access; omitted create effect is inferred, while omitted update effect keeps its stored value

enabled.description: Whether the policy is enabled; creates default to true, updates preserve the stored value when omitted

id.description: Access policy UUID from list_access_policies or create_access_policy

name.description: Policy name, unique within the workspace (1-64 characters)

subjects.description: Complete subject list; updates replace the existing subjects. A side without entries matches requests without that principal

id.description: Subject ID; ANY matches all users or all agents, but cannot identify a group

type.description: Subject kind; users and agents are matched independently

targets.description: Complete target list; updates replace the existing targets

server_id.description: MCP server UUID or slug in the workspace; responses return the UUID

tools.description: ALL tools on the server, or a nonempty list of tool names

models.description: ALL models or a nonempty list of model slugs; omitted defaults to ALL in Portkey

provider_id.description: Provider UUID or slug in the workspace; responses return the UUID

version.description: Current version from get_access_policy; a stale version returns HTTP 409

name: update_access_policy

data.description: Structured success payload when ok is true

error.description: Structured error payload when ok is false

ok.description: Whether the tool call succeeded and returned structured data
